results.title: Pete Hegseth says Colombia's new president has requested U.S. collaboration in anti-drug efforts
results.description: PANAMA CITY — U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Wednesday said the recently inaugurated government of Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella has requested U.S. collaboration in joint military operations in Colombia to combat “narco-terrorism.” During a meeting of the so-called Americas Counter-Cartel Coalition in Panama, Hegseth said Colombia would also ...
